name: Strategic Visual Storytelling Using Claude and Perplexity
headline: Strategic Visual Storytelling with Perplexity
short_description: This skill guides users in leveraging the combined strengths of Perplexity and Claude 3.7 to enhance strategic visual storytelling. It enables users to gather real-time data from Perplexity and transform it into insightful, visually engaging presentations using Claude's artifact features.
author: shyft-ai

sections.overview:
The Strategic Visual Storytelling skill with Perplexity and Claude 3.7 is designed to empower users in creating compelling visual narratives by leveraging real-time data. This skill integrates the data-gathering capabilities of Perplexity with Claude's powerful presentation features, allowing users to transform complex information into visually engaging stories. By utilizing this skill, users can create presentations that not only inform but also captivate their audience, making data-driven insights more accessible and understandable. One of the key benefits of this skill is its ability to streamline the storytelling process, saving users significant time in presentation preparation. While the exact time savings are not quantified, the efficiency gained from automating data collection and visual creation can be substantial. Users can expect to complete their presentations in just one hour, allowing them to focus on strategic messaging rather than manual data manipulation. This skill is particularly valuable for marketers, product managers, and AI practitioners who need to convey complex ideas succinctly and effectively. Ideal for professionals in content creation and marketing departments, this skill is perfect for those tasked with presenting data to stakeholders or clients. Use cases include creating visual presentations for business stakeholders, transforming intricate data sets into engaging visual stories, and generating data-driven infographics for marketing campaigns. For instance, a product manager can utilize this skill to present market research findings in a visually appealing format, enhancing understanding and retention among team members. With an intermediate implementation difficulty, users should be comfortable navigating both Perplexity and Claude 3.7. This skill fits seamlessly into AI-first workflows by automating the data gathering and visualization process, enabling users to create impactful presentations with minimal effort. By integrating AI automation into their storytelling, users can elevate their communication strategies and drive better decision-making in their organizations.
Creating visual presentations for business stakeholders
Transforming complex data into engaging visual stories
Generating data-driven infographics for marketing
sections.setup: No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
sections.usage:
```
Use Perplexity to gather the latest industry reports and relevant data about [INDUSTRY]. Download and prepare these sources in PDF format. Set up a new project in Claude. Upload the gathered documents and set custom instructions for the desired visual output, such as [CHART_TYPE]. Use Claude to generate an interactive dashboard that includes strategic recommendations based on the data provided. Ensure that thinking mode is enabled for comprehensive analysis.
```
Copy

```
An interactive dashboard with sections like 'Growth Rates' featuring bar charts, line charts for trends, and pie charts for market share, all following the specified brand color theme. Strategic insights and recommendations are clearly highlighted for stakeholder presentations.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf
